 Benito Skinner’s drip, Cynthia Nixon’s favorite lesbian, & a walk through gay history
 Matthew Tharrett 
 November 8, 2026, 11:00 am PST 
 Check out this year’s best Halloween outfits from queer celebs , then catch up on the latest from Gay TikTok:
 Johnny Palmadessa droppped off a job application for Susan Collins .
 Theo fed his husband.
 Cynthia Nixon named her favorite lesbian.
 A man on the street revealed his gay awakening.
 Bryan Johnston covered himself.
 Rhys Ross walked through gay history at The Stonewall Inn .
 Benito Skinner served MAN.
 Derek Hough and Blake McGrath had a grocery store dance-off.
 How about we take this to the next level? 
 Subscribe to our newsletter for a refreshing cocktail (or mocktail) of LGBTQ+ entertainment and pop culture, served up with a side of eye-candy.
 Troye Sivan felt inspired.
 And Martha Stewart explained her controversial Halloween costume.
